title: PlaneMem durable and legacy handoff claims
description: Source-only keyed claim/current result/original receipt plus unkeyed HTTP compatibility. Register handoff-create.json, handoff-read.json, session-activity-read.json and session-start.json locally.
$comment: Static schemas do not select a branch from external headers or enforce identity/path/target binding, paired-version arithmetic and current-versus-receipt relationships. Wire claim records are less strictly checked than SDK output. No validator/generator/runtime evidence.

unparsedSources.description: Wire claim store maps/clones saved source_refs without validating entries, count, uniqueness or checkpoint membership. SDK separately requires valid normalized sources<=200 and checkpoint membership.

command.description: Exact original effective version1..MAX_SAFE-1 even for unchanged result, plus optional original path/client fields. No actor/require_claimed/key/unknown fields. Optional path/client must equal requested handoff and verified original client.

handoff_id.description: Raw same-named body value is overwritten by route before strict command parsing/fingerprinting; unlike create session_id no raw equality check.

durableBody.description: Selected when key exists in header OR body. Original positive version required in header/body; if both present they must agree, as must header/body keys. Version header can supply missing body version. Unknown fields rejected after path override/key extraction.

expected_version.description: Optional; effective header wins. Without header supplied body must be safe nonnegative number. Legacy already-claimed same-owner return occurs before version comparison.

legacyBody.description: Only when BOTH header and body key absent. Unknown fields allowed/ignored after signed top-level identity checks. Version optional; generic headers still must agree. No durable command receipt, no original-key lookup proof.

body.description: Header-dependent union: a header key requires DurableBody even if body lacks key. Schema alone cannot enforce this external-header branch selection.

handoff_id.description: Raw outer field overwritten by path then removed before query parse; optional nested claim.handoff_id must match path.

receiptBody.description: Original version in claim determines fingerprint. New header key/version are parsed then ignored, unlike creation receipt which rejects them.

binding.description: Copied scalar original query plus fixed complete identity/scope/handoff. Not credentials, not an HTTP body.

recorded.description: Exact original handoff/version/verified actor+client, linked parent/checkpoint. handoff_version=expected_version+(changed?1:0). changed=false confirms this command made no ownership change; it does not attribute a previous claim. No current state, times, notes or pack metadata.

wireFields.description: Complete nominal current handoff mapping; no parent session_id/created_at/updated_at/current permissions. Raw store does not apply full client name/source/target checks. Legacy fields can be weaker than durable receipt identity; no blanket use of current-read schema.

result.description: Current version>=historical receipt version; equal version requires claimed, expired only allowed at greater version. Current owner/parent/checkpoint must match receipt. Current trace can be from later transition; raw sources/names are not fully revalidated on replay. Parent session/checkpoint versions unchanged.

clientResult.description: Normalized full SDK result, complete original identity/version and current consistency checks. Optional target must equal original claiming client; sources<=200, include exact checkpoint and match normalized outer sources. Drops extra source/top-level properties, retains ordering/duplicates.

legacyResult.description: Unkeyed legacy result has no claim_receipt and may lack claimed_by_actor on an older same-client claim. Fresh open->claimed stores current verified actor/client and increments version without a safe overflow guard; already claimed returns unchanged before optional version check. Nominal shape, not complete stored-row validation.

envelope.description: Current handoff and original claim receipt, matching raw inner/outer sources/current outer trace. No built-in ETag/outer revision.

clientEnvelope.description: Optional compatible ETag must equal CURRENT version, not original expected/historical receipt version. Exact current trace checked. Generic SDK transport supplies no dedicated response-byte or whole-call bound.

receiptEnvelope.description: Minimal historical result after selected current ownership/version/parent/checkpoint checks; does not read current source/trace/sender/target fields or pack. SDK requires exact name-bounded trace and no ETag. not-observed cannot establish failure or attribute legacy ownership.
